approval._doc: mode never: no human approval anywhere; tiers in auto_tiers execute on their own at any hour, other tiers are recorded as refused and not traded. mode online_hours: the earlier model (proposals 10-22 local, offline_auto_tiers overnight).

carry._settings_doc: 2026-11-01, the owner's decision: the setting the lab's carry simulator v2 kept choosing (recipe car-6485434d). BTC and ETH only, a slow funding average (about 12 days) and a wide gap between entry and exit (it holds through brief negative funding), so it trades rarely and fees no longer eat the funding. per_asset_cap lets one coin use almost the whole pot when it is the only one in; with both in, each gets half. Pairs in coins that left the basket are unwound.
carry._execution_doc: taker: both legs trade together with immediate-or-cancel orders, so a pair is never one-legged (replayed on 205 days of real hourly data: hedge P&L -8 vs -79 for maker orders with a 1h fix and -158 for the old engine, on a 1000 pot). maker: resting post-only orders; a lagging leg completes at market after max_unhedged_hours. Legs are equal in coins; the pair is re-sized only when its notional drifts more than resize_band from target.

_agent_note: Carry (Doctrine build 1): short perp + long spot, collect funding. Frozen in docs/specs/CARRY.md. Paper only until the Phase 4 testnet run sets carry_live_validated. Throttle is tight because a delta-neutral book should barely draw down; a 5% drawdown means something is broken.
